entities.name: Methos
entities.description: Deeply religious human of Kenlefia following the Old Way, who died of thirst just short of Vacar Slab.

entities.name: Ophelia
entities.description: Methos's sister, convinced to join the escort.

entities.name: Teeth
entities.description: Water-bearer who fell off a cliff with most of the water.

entities.name: Cleatin
entities.description: Gray Ogre protector killed by a Duneclaw.

entities.name: Vacar Slab
entities.description: Desert place where Kenlefia metes justice.

entities.name: Aerathi berserkers
entities.description: Ambushed and killed two of the party.

events.summary: Methos convinces his sister Ophelia to join him escorting the prisoner called the Abuser and eight others to Vacar Slab.
events.quote: he convinced his sister Ophelia to join him in escorting a prisoner they called the Abuser there

events.summary: On the perilous journey, party members die: two to Aerathi berserkers, one to a viper, Teeth by a fall, D'Bray of thirst, and Cleatin to a Duneclaw.
events.quote: The journey was perilous, and the party members started dying sequentially.

events.summary: Methos collapses within a day of the goal and dies of thirst.
events.quote: Methos collapsed within a day of reaching their goal
